## 💫 About Me:

I’m an **AI and Analytics professional** with extensive experience across early-stage startups, global organizations, and academic research, where I’ve built data, ML, and AI solutions across healthcare, marketing, supply chain, and compliance.

I work across the full spectrum from predictive modeling and analytics to LLM systems, computer vision, and multimodal AI. I’m particularly interested in building **reliable AI systems and rigorous evaluation frameworks** that connect model performance to real-world outcomes.

My background spans **accounting and finance, supply chain, business analytics, and leadership**, with a natural progression into **AI, machine learning, and applied research**.

Across P&G, Manito Mix, VertekAI, and Northeastern, I’ve moved from solving business problems with data to building and researching AI systems.

## Research and projects

- **MotionBlind** · co-authored preprint · 2026 · [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09528) · [code](https://github.com/ostadabbas/MotionBlind)\
  The benchmark uses clip pairs that differ only in motion. Six open Video-LLMs answer 52 to 59% of yes/no questions correctly. They get every answer right on only 3.3 to 11.7% of pairs, near the 6.25% chance level. I recorded clips, ran evaluation sweeps, and helped with analysis, writing, and figures.
- **KAPPA** · RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection challenge · since 2026\
  A 2.5D CNN predicts 12 knee abnormalities across 4,400 MRI studies. An ensemble scores 0.871 macro ROC-AUC on the public leaderboard.
- **Boston311** · Predictive Modeling · 2025 · [code](https://github.com/as-obaid/boston311)\
  When a Boston 311 request opens, a CatBoost model predicts whether it will miss its SLA. It scores 0.955 ROC-AUC, largely by learning which request types stay open.
